# Celpe-Dê Pé — celpe-depe.com

> Independent free preparation for the Celpe-Bras exam (Portuguese as a foreign language):
> writing practice, theory, exercises, past exams and analyses.
> Content in Portuguese (pt-BR), with English and Russian mirrors for key pages.

> Celpe-Dê Pé is not affiliated with Inep/MEC. Registration, notices, results and certificates
> are handled only through official Inep channels and the Celpe-Bras System.

## Main pages

- [Home (pt-BR)](https://celpe-depe.com/pt-br): start here — writing level check and study paths.
- [Writing practice](https://celpe-depe.com/pt-br/escrever): free written-production practice.
- [Celpe-Bras guide](https://celpe-depe.com/pt-br/celpe-bras): exam overview, parts, criteria, levels, registration.
- [Past exams](https://celpe-depe.com/pt-br/provas-anteriores): archive by session.
- [Celpe-Bras 2026/1](https://celpe-depe.com/pt-br/provas-anteriores/2026-1): latest full session materials.
- [Theory](https://celpe-depe.com/pt-br/teoria): grammar and structures.
- [Practice](https://celpe-depe.com/pt-br/pratica): skill exercises and strategies.
- [Blog](https://celpe-depe.com/pt-br/blog): task analyses and study tips.
- [Contact](https://celpe-depe.com/pt-br/contato): message the team.

## Official sources (not this site)

- [Celpe-Bras — Inep](https://www.gov.br/inep/pt-br/areas-de-atuacao/avaliacao-e-exames-educacionais/celpe-bras)
- [Sistema Celpe-Bras](https://celpebras.inep.gov.br)
- [Postos aplicadores](https://www.gov.br/inep/pt-br/areas-de-atuacao/avaliacao-e-exames-educacionais/celpe-bras/postos-aplicadores)

## Notes

- Primary content language: Brazilian Portuguese (pt-BR).
- Official exam facts are published by Inep/MEC; verify dates and rules on the official sources above.
